w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: Back at the haven the argument starts: Marisol is calling it "Old Gavel." They'll fight it out — weigh in if you want.

w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Darnell just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Callback is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w3Mentions.name: Buffering
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🐗 RAID — 4 raiders (The Paparazzo, Loud-Eyes, Buffering, Loud-Eyes) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! The palisade's stakes take their toll as they come over the wall.

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — Ad Break.

w5Mentions.name: The Editor
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Editor.
firstContext: 💛 You hold Dispatcher's headset. You learned the voice — low, steady, unhurried. 'Panic is just information arriving too fast.' You hear it in your own voice now when it counts. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they know your hands. The feast was the weapon.
Something moves out there — The Editor.
👁️ Renato freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."
This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: It's settled. The village is calling it "The Ugly Beast." The Codex keeps it.
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)

📺 SYSTEM: "The cameras want a new face. Amina — the galaxy is about to learn your name."

w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Network Note.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A full seat. global standing, every wave faced, the deeds complete. The table rises when you enter. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 2 · Forage 22 · Craft 7 · Talk 19 · Explore 36 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE BELOVED — "Speak for the quiet ones."
◈ THE ARCHITECT — Yuki Mori ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.
